messages:
maria: Kicking off a canary to 10% now in the 10:00-11:00 UTC change window. Deploy ID: deploy-2026-03-23-10. Dash: https://dash.re/canary/deploy-2026-03-23 :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy started — deploy-2026-03-23 at 10:02 UTC. Canary target: 10% across us-west/us-east. Rollout policy: 0->10 over 5m. Logs: https://logs.re/deploy-2026-03-23

aj: seeing a small uptick in 5xxs on embed route at 10:05 — 0.1% -> 0.9% in 2m :eyes: https://dash.re/metrics/embed

maria: @aj can you paste the numbers and say if it's client or server side?

aj: snapshot:
```
embed_latency_p75: 230ms -> 940ms
embed_5xx_count: 12 -> 98
```
Feels infra-related. Holding the lift to 10% until we confirm.

sanjay: infra check: pod count OK, no OOMs. But KV cache evictions spiked at shift: 2/min -> 120/min. Looks like cache pressure from longer sequences.

hannah: if evictions are driving errors, propose rollback to v2.3.1 and pin, then investigate. Change window ~45m left.

maria: pause at 10% for 5m and if no improvement we rollback. @deploy-bot can you prepare pin/rollback options?

deploy-bot: available actions: `pause`, `rollback --to <tag>`, `pin --version <tag>`. Run `/deploy action <action>` to execute.

aj: vote: rollback. We hit this with tokenizer change in staging.

sanjay: vote: hold + investigate 5m; rollback if evictions persist.

hannah: vote: rollback to v2.3.1 and pin until fix validated.

maria: consensus = rollback. Triggering safe rollback to v2.3.1 and notifying support.

maria: `/deploy rollback --to v2.3.1 --deploy-id deploy-2026-03-23 --reason "canary 10% spike kv-evictions"`

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for deploy-2026-03-23. Rolling back 100% of canary traffic to v2.3.1. ETA ~2m. Notifying infra and monitoring.

aj: error rate dropping in last 90s, p75 latency improving. Nice.

sanjay: infra confirms KV evictions back to baseline. We'll file a follow-up and attach traces.

hannah: adding a short release-note addendum: "Rolled back canary deploy-2026-03-23 due to KV cache pressure; investigating tokenizer path impact." Updating release notes page and customer comms if needed.

maria: pinning v2.3.1 for the change window: `/deploy pin --version v2.3.1`

deploy-bot: version v2.3.1 pinned until 2026-03-23T11:00:00Z. Incident ticket INC-2026-142 opened.

aj: :thumbsup: I'll bisect the tokenizer change and post findings in INC-2026-142.

maria: meeting note: stop/go call outcome: hold at 10%, rollback and pin. Follow-ups in incident ticket. :white_check_mark:

hannah: assigning follow-ups: infra owner @sanjay, regression owner @aj.

maria: closing thread, thanks all.
